project_title: Raja Raja Cholan vs The British Empire
concept: Alternate history epic cinematic war scene

lighting.atmosphere: sharp sun rays cutting through battlefield dust and cannon smoke

setting.location: vast arid plains of Tamil Nadu with ancient temple ruins in the background
setting.environment: churned red earth, dry grass, distant stone gopurams, scorched horizon

attire.armor: ornate cast-bronze chestplate with intricate tiger motifs
attire.garments: deep crimson silk veeshti with woven gold borders (kasavu)
attire.adornments: royal rudraksha malas, gold shoulder-guards (tholu valai), gem-encrusted royal turban crown
attire.weapon: forged steel Chola curved sword (vaai vaal) and circular shield embossed with the royal tiger emblem

commander.pose: standing fiercely at the center foreground, rallying the frontline troops

troops.details: white and ochre dhotis hitched up (veera katcham), leather torso bands, bronze bangles, chest harness straps
troops.weaponry: long spears (vel), double-edged broadswords, bows, recurve arrows, war drums (murasu)

troops.uniform: 1930s interwar khaki service-dress, pith helmets (foreign service helmets), leather bandoliers, puttees
troops.weaponry: Lee-Enfield rifles with fixed bayonets, Vickers machine-gun emplacements, early field artillery

visual_composition.foreground: Raja Raja Cholan leading the vanguard with a raised sword, foot soldiers charging forward
visual_composition.midground: dramatic clash of traditional bronze shields against bayonets, dust plumes, dynamic battle motion
visual_composition.background: ranks of khaki-clad soldiers, artillery positions, a towering Chola gopuram silhouetted against a bright tropical sky
